summary: Two ill-equipped men in tank tops and shorts plus their dog got lost attempting to climb 13,409-ft Navajo Peak in the Indian Peaks Wilderness; they called 911 by satellite phone ~5:30 p.m. Saturday. Flight for Life located them near the summit of Shoshoni Peak and flew rescuers to Pawnee Pass; technical rescue overnight; all back at Brainard Lake ~7:30 a.m. Sunday. No injuries.
location: Navajo Peak / Shoshoni Peak, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue / Indian Peaks Fire District / Boulder County Sheriff's Office ES / Flight for Life
notes: Incident Saturday 2018-09-15 (Saturday-verified; article posted 2018-09-18); rescue completed Sunday 2018-09-16. Dog rescued with the two men (victims=2, human-only convention).
